relations.text: 2025年に連結売上高の約10.6%を占めた顧客である
relations.text_en: Amazon.com, Inc. and its affiliates represented approximately 10.6% of consolidated revenues in 2025

source.label: UPS 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In 2025, one customer, Amazon.com, Inc. and its affiliates, represented approximately 10.6% of our consolidated revenues, substantially all of which was within our U.S. Domestic Package segment.
